mapper.update: update user u join ( select user_id uid, count(*) as nums from submit where user_id in #{id} group by user_id ) as s on u.id = s.uid set u.total_submit = s.nums where u.total_submit != s.nums;
mapper.select: select date_format(submit_time, '%Y-%m-%d') as statDate, count(*) as count from submit where user_id = #{userId} and submit_time >= #{since} group by statDate order by statDate
